openwrt_wiki.Serial: place for a standard uart header, pinout written on the PCB; RC04 has no marks for UART
openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: compact, wall-wart type range extender with 2x2 Wifi5 dual band hardware. 20€ in 2022 in Germany. Installation through an app, no HTML UI. Limitations: 100Mbit LAN port and 64MB RAM. Newer version Model RC04 looks identical, harder to install. Avoid.
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: single screw under the barcode label, right side; unit splits into power supply and wifi part; 'hot' parts shielded
openwrt_wiki.Failsafe: hidden reset button near the ethernet connector; big WPS button on the front does nothing at this stage
openwrt_wiki.Debricking: Xiaomi-typisch Reset beim Booten -> TFTP-Anforderung eines signierten Bootloaders; keine installierbare Stock-Firmware bekannt
openwrt_wiki.Alternative Firmware: mi-router-4a-100m (nicht -intl) läuft, LAN dann als WAN
openwrt_wiki.OEM-Bootlog: U-Boot 1.1.3 (Jun 10 2021), DRAM 64 MB (512 Mbits DDR, width 16), SPI-NOR JEDEC ef4018 W25Q128BV, Ralink UBoot 4.3.0.0, ASIC 7628_MP, CPU freq 575 MHz; Linux 3.10.14; mtd: Bootloader 0x0-0x20000, Config, Factory 0x30000, crash, cfg_bak, overlay 0x60000-0x160000, OS1 0x160000-0x8a0000, OS2 0x8a0000-0xfe0000; mt7628_xq_board=RA75

openwrt_git.Titel: ramips: add support for xiaomi RA75 Range Extender
openwrt_git.Beschreibung: 'Range extender' variant of the Xiaomi 4A router, identical to the 100m non-intl/chinese version; differences form factor, LEDs, WPS button and one 100M port only. Stock firmware 'app managed only'.
openwrt_git.MAC Addresses: All 3 MACs are read from flash and identical to stock. Label MAC is WIFI 2G
openwrt_git.Installation: No HTML UI on this device, serial console only. The serial connector is unpopulated but standard size and clearly marked. Flash from the U-Boot shell at boot by choosing (2) and flashing the sysupgrade file via tftp.

openwrt_git_led.Text: RA75 has 5 physical LEDs under 2 indicators, mixed with light pipes: System GPIO0 blue, GPIO2 amber; Signal GPIO44 blue, GPIO37 amber, GPIO46 red. GPIO46 is used for UART1 by default.

openwrt_git_mac.Text: The label-mac of the repeater is the address used on the 2.4 GHz radio, not the ethernet MAC.
